items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: my father took his regular orchestra out there, which was -- included in there was my mother, who was a piano player, and he brought me

ctx.x: He played for the stag parties for Jack Warner and Warner Brothers, things like that. The first time I ever went to a stag party and saw what a real stag party was was the big-

time party they gave at the Beverly Hills Riding Academy for Jack Warner when he was taking his first trip to Europe. I was very, very low teenager. I was -- as a matter of fact, it was in 1926, so you can add from 1926 from 1912 and you'll get it. I was 14 years old. I worked with the family orchestra at this big stag party and the funny thing is nobody actually knew it was a stag party. My dad didn't know it was a stag party because when the call came in, my father took his regular orchestra out there, which…

So, when we got there and Marco Hellman saw my mother, he says, "My God, Royal," he says, "what is she doing here?" He says, "Why didn't you tell me what kind of party it was?" So he says, "She'll have to go home." So my dad says, "Naturally." So, he put her in his Rolls Royce and had her driven home by his chauffeur. But my dad made sure that I stayed because he says, he wanted to make sure that I saw everything that was happening in this life, so that nothing would be new to me.
